name: com.federicocolombo.volumetricsdf
description: Real-time procedural implicit CSG raymarching, bounded modifier volumes, triplanar texturing, and 128^3 GPU voxelization with decoupled chromatic evaluation for Unity VFX Graph and Mobile XR (Meta Quest 3).
